categories.main_business_segments: Haoyun Technologies primarily operates in low-code smart IoT data platforms, enterprise-wide digital empowerment engines, and big data operation services. Its business spans low-code development platforms, IoT platforms, streaming media, UWB high-precision positioning, big data, proprietary domain large models, cloud computing, edge computing, and AI. Key industry applications include financial IoT, smart campuses, smart energy, and public safety. The company also develops AI-powered enterprise digitalization products and big data and AI solutions for law enforcement and traffic management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages model-driven low-code technology with drag-and-drop interfaces, AI low-code generation engines, real-time knowledge assistants, and multi-modal AI integration. Its IoT platform integrates business operation systems with IoT devices, supporting complex strategy execution and multi-cloud deployment. Proprietary technologies include AI-OCR, AI knowledge bases, AI smart customer service, contract and bid AI auditing, AI resume screening, AI meeting assistants, and AI WeChat assistants. Big data platforms utilize machine learning for multi-dimensional data analysis, and AI-powered video structural analysis enhances security monitoring.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Haoyun serves primarily financial institutions, educational institutions, energy sectors, public safety agencies, and various enterprises undergoing digital transformation. Its financial IoT solutions dominate its revenue, with growing presence in education and energy. The company also targets automotive aftermarket, international trade, e-commerce, private domain malls, and advertising marketing sectors for its enterprise digital empowerment products. Public security and traffic management departments are key users of its big data and AI products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Guangzhou, China, with a nationwide service and operation network including 40 branches and 57 offices across China. Major revenue contributions come from South China, Central China, North China, Northeast, Northwest, and Southwest regions. It primarily operates within China, with no significant overseas operations disclosed.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haoyun operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the digital technology supply chain, focusing on software development, system integration, platform services, and digital transformation solutions. It develops proprietary platforms and applications, integrating hardware IoT devices and software services, serving end customers directly with digital solutions and services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment in AI technologies, low-code platform innovation, proprietary domain large models, and AI integration. Strategic priorities include expanding digital empowerment for SMEs, enhancing smart IoT platforms with AI and UWB technologies, and deepening applications in financial IoT, smart campuses, and energy sectors. It also focuses on developing AI-powered enterprise digital engines and big data analytics, with ongoing projects in distributed file storage, cloud video streaming, RPA systems, and integrated digital management platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Haoyun generates revenue mainly through direct sales of low-code and IoT platform construction and solutions, IoT devices and software sales, and operational services such as safe city operations and leasing income. Revenue is recognized based on contract fulfillment, including point-in-time and over-time recognition depending on service type. The company also earns investment income from financial assets and subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Haoyun positions itself as a leading provider of low-code smart IoT platforms and enterprise digital empowerment solutions in China. It holds a strong market presence in financial IoT and is expanding in education, energy, and public safety sectors. The company emphasizes its comprehensive technology stack, AI integration, and extensive service network as competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Haoyun reported revenues of approximately RMB 344 million, a 5.64% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -35.12 million, though the loss narrowed by 40.16%. The company maintains a stable financial position with a low asset-liability ratio of 9.20% and cash and equivalents of RMB 403.85 million. R&D investment increased to RMB 58.99 million, accounting for 17.13% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented strategy despite short-term profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haoyun differentiates itself through its integrated low-code platform combined with AI capabilities, enabling rapid, flexible, and cost-effective digital application development. Its platform supports complex IoT device integration and full lifecycle management, enhanced by AI-driven engines for code generation and real-time knowledge assistance. The company offers a comprehensive digital empowerment ecosystem that breaks down data silos, supports multi-modal AI collaboration, and delivers tailored solutions across industries, emphasizing agility, scalability, and intelligent decision-making to drive customer efficiency and innovation.
